context: Naoko and Mrs. Mori watch a debate show; cheering loudly for one side.
purpose: Two older women engaging civically with media.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Wow — this debate is actually fun!
lines.style: Loud, brassy opening with genuine delight. Kansai accent full and present. Quick attack on the first word, sustained brightness through. Generous and unselfconscious energy.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: うん、主張がはっきりしてるわ。
lines.en: Mm-hmm, the arguments are really clear.
lines.style: Warm, observant nod. Soft-spoken, genuinely engaged. No performance — just a neighbor noticing quality. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: こっちの人、応援するで!
lines.style: Pure animated enthusiasm from the aunt. Kansai energy cranked up. Bouncy, emphatic on the commitment. The kind of loudness that fills a room without being mean.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: Heh — you're really into it, aren't you?
lines.style: Gentle, knowing amusement. Soft teasing — the kind of warm ribbing you don't mind. Slight trailing lilt at the end, affectionate observation rather than criticism.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 当たり前や、関心ある話題!
lines.en: Well of course — it's a topic I actually care about!
lines.style: Spirited defense with Kansai assertiveness. Quick, lively tempo. Pride in her own engagement without being defensive. Bright and unapologetic.
